name: rating-bars
title: Rating Bars
description: A short qualitative rating — a label, a row of lit and unlit segments and the word that says what it means — read as one meter. Server-safe.

meta.whenToUse: Rating something on a small fixed scale with a word that says what it means — a model's speed, cost and quality in a picker's details, stacked so the rows compare down the column.
meta.whenNotToUse: A live or continuous value (Progress, LevelMeter); a user's own star rating input; an exact number or a price (show the figure).
